## Issues Found

### Minor (worth fixing, does not block)

- `scripts/verify_task_body.py:7415`: **`git status` takes the optional index lock on the SHARED repo root.** This is the verifier's first `git status` call site (checks 15/29 use lock-free `cat-file`/`ls-tree`/`rev-parse`); `git status` opportunistically refreshes the index, briefly holding `.git/index.lock` at the resolved MAIN checkout — the shared root where index.lock collisions are a documented fleet pain point (CLAUDE.md § Concurrent repo-root committers). Window is milliseconds per dir and the fleet already retries collisions, hence Minor.
  - Fix: add `--no-optional-locks` (i.e. `["git", "--no-optional-locks", "-c", "core.quotePath=off", "status", ...]`) — zero output change, eliminates the lock entirely.
  - Mechanizable: yes — grep the call site for `--no-optional-locks` (1-line pytest string-pin).
  - Bug-class sweep (`git status` on shared root): only one `git status` site in the file — no siblings.
- `scripts/verify_task_body.py:7414-7421` (standing rec; pre-existing house pattern, NOT a round regression): `text=True` + `core.quotePath=off` means a filename with invalid-UTF-8 bytes under a probed dir would raise `UnicodeDecodeError` (a `ValueError`) inside `subprocess.run`, uncaught by `(OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError)` — and `verify_text` dispatches `[chk(body) for chk in CHECKS[1:]]` with no per-check try/except, so the whole verifier would crash. The identical catch-tuple + `quotePath=off` pattern already exists at :7063 and :11264 (git-provenance: pre-existing-on-trunk pattern, verified by grep), and non-UTF-8 filenames have never been observed in this repo. If hardened, harden all three sites together (`errors="replace"` or add `ValueError` to the tuple).
  - Mechanizable: yes (grep catch tuples adjacent to `text=True` subprocess calls).
- Cosmetic: a staged-rename porcelain line (`R  old.json -> new.json`) renders its path field as `old.json -> new.json` in the WARN note (classified modified-class — correct class, slightly odd display). Not worth a round on its own.
